verdict.rationale: Runpod's pricing page lists a current-generation B300 (288 GB HBM3e, $8.99/hr), and a community user says H100s are easy to get on Runpod. GPU type is selectable at Pod creation via --gpu-id. Cheaper previous-generation options are only thinly evidenced: a community mention of 4090s, which also notes they became low-availability. missing for 10: a documented first-party GPU catalog showing H100/H200/B200 alongside previous-gen datacenter cards (e.g., A100) with comparative pricing, and evidence that cheaper tiers are reliably available.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can choose from current-generation datacenter GPUs (H100/H200/B200 class) as well as cheaper previous-generation options

citations.quote: B300 288 GB HBM3e 251 GB RAM 32 vCPUs $8.99/hr
even Colab Pro doesn't offer H100s, whereas you can get that pretty easily on Runpod.
Runpod used to have high availability of 4090 GPUs
